opening.argument: The segment is presented as a WIRED cooking-advice exchange in which Gordon Ramsay answers questions submitted through Twitter. Its stated format is explicit: “Gordon Ramsay uses the power of Twitter to answer some common cooking questions.” The material then provides ordinary culinary instruction, including how to mince garlic and prepare mozzarella for grating: “Mozzarella, get it nice and firm, stick it in the freezer for 10 minutes before you start grating.” Visible questions concern macaroni tenderness and ravioli pasta sheets, while the setting shows ingredients, utensils, cookware and a laptop. These features establish an educational cooking Q&A format, with no scam mechanism shown.
